steps.trigger: Pair Studio and add the two real worktrees
Read the actual listeners for two fixed Explorers with the same project name
Follow the Studio port panel to its original worktree and return to the same Explorer
Check the local summary and PTYs across the two fixed Explorer hosts
Inspect both actual listeners with host and original worktree provenance
Reject the stale listener and open its replacement in the original worktree Browser
Follow the sampled local worktree row from the Studio preview and restore the original Explorer
Stop Studio while Local still has a functioning listener
Reconnect the Studio Explorer and read its replacement listener
Withdraw Studio pairing and check the retired port panel
